name: Formcraft
summary: A form and survey builder on warm paper, where fields snap in with a spring and logic jumps draw as arrows
about: A nine-page form builder for the team at a small coffee company, in warm paper with violet ink. Drag question types onto the paper sheet and they spring into place, then set logic jumps and watch the logic map draw an arrow from question to question, with every path through the form and how many people took it. Preview runs the same form on a desktop and a phone side by side, and responses, charts per question, integrations, sharing and settings all work and keep their data in the browser.
how: Open a page from the paper sidebar: Overview, Forms, Builder, Logic map, Preview & share, Responses, Insights, Integrations or Settings
In the Builder drag a question type into the form, or click it, and watch it spring into place; drag the grip to reorder
Select a question to edit its text, options and logic jumps, and press Ctrl+Z to undo
On the Logic map drag cards around, click a path to light it up, add a jump and watch the arrow draw itself
Answer the form on the desktop and phone previews, then copy the link, the QR code or the embed code
Filter, star and open responses, export them as CSV, and read the charts for each question in Insights
Press Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, change the accent colour and reset the demo data in Settings
